oral_examination.oral_examination: 16. Deep caries and pulp on the occlusal surface, no pain during probing; sensitivity during cold examination; no obvious loosening; no pain when percussion; no other obvious abnormalities found. X-ray films showed low-density images of the coronal part and pulp, and no obvious dark shadow around the apex.

treatment_plan.definitive: 16 root canal treatments. The patient signed the informed consent.
